country_block.name: sports-cave-block-sg-public-storefront
country_block.expression: (http.host in {"www.sportscaveshop.com" "sportscaveshop.com"} and ip.src.country eq "SG" and not (cf.bot_management.verified_bot and cf.verified_bot_category eq "Search Engine Crawler"))
notes: Apply before the apex canonical redirect so the apex cannot bypass the rule.
Do not replace verified-bot identity with a User-Agent allow rule.
Ask Shopify to confirm how verified Google Merchant, Storebot and AdsBot traffic is classified before activation.
Ask Shopify to confirm a WAF block is excluded from Online Store session creation.

rate_limit_pilot.name: sports-cave-product-enumeration-managed-challenge
rate_limit_pilot.expression: (http.host in {"www.sportscaveshop.com" "sportscaveshop.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/products/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/collections/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/search") and not (cf.bot_management.verified_bot and cf.verified_bot_category eq "Search Engine Crawler"))
notes: The threshold is a conservative starting proposal, not a validated production value.
Run in log/simulate mode first and tune from actual human and bot request distributions.
Use Shopify/Cloudflare bot score, JA4 or detection signals if Shopify makes them available; do not block an ASN globally without evidence.

required_aggregates: rule matches and blocks by day
